What's wrong with the seat next to me? Why did you suddenly move away after the results came out?
...
Why won't you talk to me? Is it because of the results?
...
Come on, don't be so grumpy! The professor almost thought you were glaring at him just now.
<style="highlight">It's not what it looks like.</style>
Second place is still pretty good, right? You only missed the bonus question.
<style="highlight">Seriously, drop it.</style>
...
<style="highlight">That bonus question was about Starshower, and the professor never even mentioned it in class! How did you manage to pull it off and score full marks?</style>
Finally, you're talking. I picked that up myself after class. If you're interested, I can show you how to do it at the observatory. What do you say?

刚刚不是坐在我同桌吗，怎么考试结果一公布，你就直接搬着书走了？
……
怎么不理我？真是因为考试成绩的事吗？
……
别摆出这么不爽的表情了，刚刚教授都以为你在给他翻白眼，差点骂你一顿。
<style="highlight">想多了。</style>
第二的成绩也很好了，只是一道附加题没做对而已。
<style="highlight">闭嘴。</style>
……
<style="highlight">那道附加题严重超纲，教授根本没教过星空魔法，你到底是怎么施展出来拿到满分的？</style>
终于理人了？那是我课余时间自学的。你要是想学的话，下了课我们去天文台，我教你用这种魔法，怎么样？

document:9:358:0.text:
I worked with Cyran to break down the Starshower spell, just like we planned. Honestly, I love talking about magic with him, even if he drives me crazy sometimes. It always sparks all these interesting ideas in my head.

That conversation got me thinking. Maybe I should start my observations with that constellation today. I really hope I catch something ancient again...

(Illegible observation log)

Cyran came along to stargaze with me, but... well, he's not exactly great at it. He didn't see anything.

He seemed kind of upset about it. Maybe I should plan a surprise to cheer him up next time?

Starshower made the night sky light up with a gorgeous meteor shower! That's honestly one of the reasons I love it so much!

Too bad my plan wasn't perfect. Cyran was excited at first, but when he figured out it was from Starshower, his mood changed. He said I shouldn't have wasted his time with such a "useless" spell.

It stung when he said that about my favorite spell. How could it be useless when it brings luck and joy to anyone who sees it?

Magic is supposed to make people happy, right? From that angle, Starshower might just be the most powerful spell in Esperia!

He just sneered when I said that. To him, magic's all about power, and anything like Starshower is just a fun trick with no real use.

Oh well, I guess we'll just have to agree to disagree.
document:9:358:0.source_cn:
依照约定，和迪尔格雷一起拆解了星空魔法。跟别人一起研究魔法的感觉真好，能引发更多有趣的思考。
刚刚的讨论给了我灵感，或许今天应该从那片星象开始观测，或许能再次捕捉到上古星象……
（一段已经模糊不清的观测记录）
迪尔格雷也加入了观测。可惜，他好像不太擅长星象观测，什么都没有看到。
他的情绪有些低沉。或许下一次可以给他准备点惊喜？

不愧是我最喜欢的法术，星雨术为夜空引来了一瞬盛大的流星雨，真是美丽的景象啊。
可惜，计划只成功了一半。迪尔格雷一开始很兴奋，发现星雨术后就又黑脸了，还说我在用这种没用的法术戏弄他。
哎，这可是我最擅长、最喜欢的魔法，怎么能说它没用呢？观测星空时看到流星雨是一种幸运的事，能够带给观星的人快乐。
魔法存在的原因，不就是为人们带来快乐吗？往这个角度想想，能制造流星雨、为人们带来快乐与惊喜的星雨术，说不定才是伊索米亚最厉害的魔法呢。
迪尔格雷对此嗤之以鼻。他坚持魔法的终极目标就是强大的力量，像星雨术这种只能观赏娱乐而没有实际用途的，只能算变戏法。
算了，随他去吧。
